      foremost of all wielders of the bow!”

      come to thee, O thou bull among men! The fear that is in thy heart,

      battle. Uttered by me and like unto success personified, accept from me
      this knowledge called Pratismriti that I impart to thee, knowing thou art
      capable of receiving it. Receiving it (from thee), Arjuna will be able to

      them. He is competent to behold the gods for his asceticism and prowess.

      scarcely pleasant. In thy case, it might also be productive of anxiety to
